name: EXP-C1 · Day 0 · Delivered-rate gate (fleet injection)
description: The fleet steps its injection rate through 25/50/100/200 Hz while the phone marks the rungs. Establishes the rate the session can sustain. Abort criteria are pre-registered: delivered rate below floor, or the illuminator silent.

config.description:
Doppler features are blocked by delivery jitter, not by rate: 0 of 500 windows passed the inter-arrival gate on the earlier captures. The operator steps the injection rate on monad01; your phone only marks where each rung starts and ends, so the Rx-side delivered rate can be cut at the right boundaries.

The phone does not illuminate — it marks block boundaries and carries the truth channel. Illumination is monad01 injecting on 2.4 GHz ch11.
Two minutes while monad01 injects at 25 Hz. Pass condition, measured at the receivers: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5.
Two minutes while monad01 injects at 50 Hz. Pass condition, measured at the receivers: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5.
Two minutes while monad01 injects at 100 Hz. Pass condition, measured at the receivers: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5.
Two minutes while monad01 injects at 200 Hz. Pass condition, measured at the receivers: delivered rate at or above 100 Hz per link with inter-arrival CV below 0.5.
The rung where delivery or CV breaks is the session's ceiling. Configure the staircase below it.
